notes.title: Death From Above 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
It’s been a long march, but we’ve reached our objective: launch day!

We’re proud of the journey we’ve made, and will continue to make, as we raise funds for our charity partners in Ukraine. After 10 months in Early Access, today is the day we make version 1.0 available!

[previewyoutube=XxyMtheWtRY;full][/previewyoutube]
 
We want to thank you for your support and your feedback, for everything you have done to spread the word and make Death From Above a success. For everyone who backed us on Kickstarter or bought the game in Early Access - we salute you. For everyone who is buying the game now, welcome to the front! 

For the 1.0 Full Release, we’ve added:


 New Achievements
 New Easter eggs
 New missions
 Completed storyline
 Outro + finale
 New Game+ mode
 Slovak, Czech and Lithuanian translations
 Bonus OST track


The game has changed so much since we first hit Early Access last year, and we've created something very special - something that can make a real positive difference to real people's lives. 

But we're not just celebrating the release. In two days, we’ll commemorate another date. February 24th, 2024, is the second anniversary of open warfare in Ukraine. Two years of incessant shelling, two years of atrocities, two years of innocent civilians dying every single day. 

We must not falter in our opposition to Putin’s aggression. Now, more than ever, the people of Ukraine need our support. Take heart, friends. The night is darkest just before the dawn!

Attention operators, news incoming! 📢

The amazing group "Go_A", an electronic folk band from Ukraine, joined us and their song "Kalyna" is simply mesmerizing! 🤩
Be sure to check out our OST and give it a listen and follow their socials 💪

Furthermore, we will be presenting Death From Above at the "Games in War" conference in Gdansk and just a few days after that be part of the DevGamm Gdansk Steam Event 🥳 be sure to stay tuned for more info!

And don't forget about the biggest upcoming event: in 2 days, Thursday Feburary 22nd, Death From Above 1.0 will release, we hope you are as hyped as we are! 🚀

notes.title: Game and OST 25% off! New Update! Ukrainian Games Festival approaches!
notes.notes:
Friends, soldiers, freedom fighters, lend me your drones! We’re very pleased to announce that we’re going to be participating in Steam’s Ukrainian Games Festival, taking place between 18-24th August, 2023.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43753697/923085065a99e06bb52acf06f6eeb0f5bd983abe.jpg

We’re beyond honored to be involved in this celebration of Ukrainian talent and we can’t wait to see what other amazing games are gathered under the flag of resistance. We began this project with the express intention of supporting Ukraine and the Ukrainian people in their fight against the Russian invasion - spreading awareness and support through this sort of initiative is exactly what we were hoping to be able to do. 

To mark the occasion, we’re discounting both Death From Above and its incredible OST by a massive 25% - beginning on August 11th at 15:00 CEST, a week before the Festival begins, and lasting until its end on August 24th. 

If you already own DFA, please do take a look at the other games on offer and help to support the good causes they represent. Be strong, stand together.


We also have a new update! Check the patch notes here!

Slava Ukraini!

notes.title: For our freedom and yours! New free update to DfA arrives on Steam today!
notes.notes:
Welcome soldiers - we have some new recruits for you to meet in our latest free content update named “For our freedom and yours”! We've begun our work on the mission structure to streamline the narrative, fixed some bugs, inevitably added some new ones and generally sprinkled joy over the game, we think you’re going to like it.

The biggest news this week, however, is that we’re joined on the battlefield by two very special new units: the Kastuś Kalinoŭski Regiment from Belarus and The Polish Legion - both formed by volunteer soldiers from Ukraine’s neighbors. 

These units are putting everything on the line for the freedom of Ukraine, risking their lives as they fight alongside the troops of the Ukrainian armed forces to liberate their neighbors from Russian oppression. 

Tens of thousands of Ukrainians are on the front lines every day of course, but it’s a very special sort of soldier who will take up arms and defend the sovereignty, freedom and self-determination of another nation. We wanted to recognise that heroism by featuring skins from each unit for both your operator and drone in game. Additionally, both the game and the Steam page are now fully translated into Polish and Belarusian!

Kastuś Kalinoŭski Battalion

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43753697/e56396c2d4e8b4c733b73635ad7ffea1b60d14db.png

This unit of Belarusian volunteers, opposed to the reign of president Alexander Lukashenko, comprises around 1500 soldiers and was formed specifically to defend Ukraine against Russian aggression in 2022. The battalion is named after Kastuś Kalinoŭski, one of the leaders of the 1863 January Uprising against the Russian Empire.

Formally admitted into the Ukrainian Ground Forces under oath in 2022, the unit participated in the liberation of Irpin in the Kyiv oblast. The Battalion has not limited its objectives to the freedom of Ukraine. With the motto ‘First Ukraine, then Belarus’, unit commanders have made clear that they intend to free their homeland from Putin’s influence via Lukashenko too, telling Belarusian citizens to “Wait for the signal” to begin the operation to free Belarus.

The Polish Legion

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43753697/038e4ebe4a3940cf2bc6283e7f72ea294b4183cf.png

A more recent addition to the Ukrainian forces, the Polish Legion is formed from Polish nationals who have volunteered for the conflict. The Polish Legion is an organization uniting Polish volunteers and volunteers from other countries who defend Ukraine, Poland, and Europe against the Russian invasion. The Legion's goal is to support Ukraine in its heroic struggle against the Russian aggressor, drawing upon our shared history.  

Currently, the Legion has three divisions - Support, Combat, and Cooperation. They engage not only in active combat assistance but also in humanitarian aid. They facilitate cooperation between the Ukrainian side and foreign companies, provide innovative AI equipment and drones, establish a Training Center for Operators, and support other Polish organizations. 

We’ve also made several changes to various missions and mechanics, as well as some quality-of-life improvements. See the full list of patch notes below.


Full patch notes

A bigger 1st and 2nd mission update that brings some level changes:
- New starting location
- Updated 1st mission
- Destroying a convoy in the 2nd mission
- New tower design
- Various new assets that can be interacted with
- Radios can be switched off
- Sound effects upgraded (this will continue in the next patch)
- Our partners in Ukraine helped us to update the quality of the sounds
Updated tablet view
- More functionality to the tablet including messages and objectives in separate tabs
New skins for the drone and operator!
- Polish Legion skin on drone and operator
- Kastuś Kalinouski regiment skin on drone and operator
New secrets
- You can find a russian drone somewhere on the map
- There's a suspicious outhouse somewhere
- New posters can be found for example in the starting village
Optimizations to:
- Particle effects
- Grenade dropping
Language updates!
- Polish localization
- Belarussian localization
Intro cinematic can be replayed from the main menu
Various bug fixes
- Intro cinematic flickering fixed
Gamepad/controller mappings changed

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that the release of Death From Above, will be on the 25th of May, exclusively on Steam Early Access. The game will be priced at €9.99/$9.99. 
We’re also very proud to present our launch trailer - edited entirely from in-game footage.
 
[previewyoutube=zADYRGrEGNw;full][/previewyoutube]

In it, you’ll be able to get your first look at the details of the gameplay we’ve been putting together for you over the last few months, as well as some of the surprises we’ve added as a thank-you to our incredible community. 
 
We hope you enjoy it - please do share it with your friends! Please check the Press-kit for assets and additional information, or contact us directly!
 
Finally - we'd like to take this opportunity to thank the wonderful Ukrainian organisations we've been working with: Gis Arta, Aerorozvidka, Army of Drones and the mighty Antytila. We're very proud to have you on board. 
 
Wishlist and Follow us on Steam!
